name: 13th Generation
overview: The Scriptures reveal that God is a jealous and holy God who holds the consequences of sin across generations, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon their children up to the third and fourth generation of those who hate Him (Exodus 20:5; Deuteronomy 5:9). Yet, He is also merciful and longsuffering, abundant in goodness and truth, forgiving iniquity and transgression while maintaining justice (Exodus 34:6-7; Numbers 14:18). This tension underscores the seriousness of sin and the importance of faithfulness, as well as the call to teach future generations about the praises and mighty works of the Lord (Psalms 78:4).
